text: Agent Bench AB Agent Bench Independent agent benchmarks Start Dashboard Tests Comparisons Security Runs GitHub Independent agent benchmarks I run reproducible benchmarks on AI agent systems. I measure what agents keep and retrieve, what they hand to the prompt, how much it costs, and what breaks once MCP enters the execution path. I am an independent tester with no affiliation to the systems I measure. Memory is where I started, comparing options like Honcho, Mem0, Hindsight, Mnemosyne and Sibyl, and the results, caveats and rerun files are all below.
